proposed_real_evaluation.selection_rule: After approved asset acquisition: sort eligible IDs, sample 10 without replacement using seed 1729, save IDs and hashes before loading a model. Never substitute tasks based on outcomes.
eligibility: Python algorithm with a known target function and offline tests
AST-selected dependency context fits at most 50 source lines
The unchanged buggy version fails development tests
Reference passes both development and independently checked hidden tests
proposed_real_evaluation.development_hidden_split: Freeze before model evaluation; hidden checks run once on the first candidate accepted by development checks, and never drive sampling or repairs.
proposed_real_evaluation.repair_policy: Fresh samples only in step 1. A later repair ablation may use at most 2 rounds within the same total generation budget.
proposed_real_evaluation.cards: No cards in the first baseline; matched-budget cards/no-cards comparison later.
proposed_real_evaluation.decision_gate: At least 30 percent task success per tier is a pilot continuation signal, with raw counts and uncertainty; do not average a failing tier away.
proposed_real_evaluation.memory_accounting: Model must execute inside the same task cgroup. Disable mmap for private weight allocation, or independently validate accounting of shared file-backed pages. Count OOMs/timeouts. Record cold-start/load time separately and include it in total task time.
